doc:document.ce:title: Sodium-ion battery cathode materials: degradation mechanisms and design strategies

ce:abstract.ce:para: Sodium-ion batteries are a promising alternative to lithium-ion systems for stationary storage. This review summarizes degradation mechanisms of layered oxide cathodes and outlines design strategies including element substitution and electrolyte additives.
